concepts.proposed_markdown: The collected JavaScript v3 credit-card guide distinguishes Hosted Fields from Card Fields: JavaScript v3 supports Hosted Fields but does not support Card Fields, while that guide lists client-side Card Fields only for Android v5 and iOS v7. Keep this boundary SDK- and version-qualified; the named native availability does not establish support in other versions. [[source-braintree-credit-cards-client-javascript-v3]]
warnings: Treat the support statements as specific to the collected website snapshot and the named SDK versions; do not infer support for sibling or later versions.
The guide points to Hosted Fields for SAQ A eligibility, but it does not establish or guarantee a merchant's PCI compliance.
